description: This file defines React components and functions for rendering and managing an action list UI in a trace viewer, including action tree rendering, action detail display, and title formatting.

classes.name: ActionList
classes.description: React functional component rendering a list of actions with tree view, selection, and detail rendering.

methods.name: renderAction
methods.description: Renders a visual representation of an action, including duration, errors, warnings, and attachments.

methods.name: renderTitleForCall
methods.description: Generates a formatted title and React elements for an action call, replacing placeholders with parameters.
